import json, re
from pathlib import Path
asset_root = Path('tasks/t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp/assets/paper/10.1016_j.neuron.2012.08.041')

# Validate details.json
with open(asset_root / 'details.json', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    details = json.load(f)

errors = []
warnings = []

required_fields = ['spec_version', 'paper_id', 'doi', 'title', 'url', 'date_published', 'year', 'authors', 'institutions', 'journal', 'venue_type', 'categories', 'abstract', 'citation_key', 'summary_path', 'files', 'download_status', 'download_failure_reason', 'added_by_task', 'date_added']
for f in required_fields:
    if f not in details:
        errors.append(f'PA-E005: missing field {f}')

# folder name match
if details.get('paper_id') != asset_root.name:
    errors.append(f'PA-E004: paper_id {details.get("paper_id")} != folder {asset_root.name}')

# venue_type
if details.get('venue_type') not in ('journal', 'conference', 'workshop', 'preprint', 'book', 'thesis', 'technical_report', 'other'):
    errors.append(f'PA-E010: invalid venue_type {details.get("venue_type")}')

# files exist
for fp in details.get('files', []):
    if not (asset_root / fp).exists():
        errors.append(f'PA-E008: file {fp} does not exist')

# spec_version
if 'spec_version' not in details:
    errors.append('PA-E013: missing spec_version')

# download_status
ds = details.get('download_status')
if ds not in ('success', 'failed'):
    errors.append(f'PA-E015: download_status invalid: {ds}')
if ds == 'failed' and not details.get('download_failure_reason'):
    errors.append('PA-E014: download_status=failed but no reason')

# Validate summary
sp = asset_root / details.get('summary_path', 'summary.md')
if not sp.exists():
    errors.append('PA-E002: canonical summary missing')
else:
    text = sp.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    # Check frontmatter
    if not text.startswith('---'):
        errors.append('PA-E012: missing YAML frontmatter')
    fm_match = re.search(r'^---\s*(.+?)\s*---', text, re.DOTALL)
    if fm_match:
        fm = fm_match.group(1)
        if f'paper_id: "{details["paper_id"]}"' not in fm:
            errors.append('PA-E007: paper_id in summary frontmatter mismatch')
        if f'citation_key: "{details["citation_key"]}"' not in fm:
            errors.append('PA-E006: citation_key in summary frontmatter mismatch')
        if 'spec_version' not in fm:
            errors.append('PA-E013: spec_version missing from summary frontmatter')
    # Check sections
    sections = ['## Metadata', '## Abstract', '## Overview', '## Architecture, Models and Methods', '## Results', '## Innovations', '## Datasets', '## Main Ideas', '## Summary']
    for sec in sections:
        if sec not in text:
            errors.append(f'PA-E009: missing section: {sec}')
    # Word count
    word_count = len(text.split())
    if word_count < 500:
        warnings.append(f'PA-W001: summary word count {word_count} < 500')
    # Results bullet count
    results_match = re.search(r'## Results\n\n(.+?)\n## Innovations', text, re.DOTALL)
    if results_match:
        results = results_match.group(1)
        bullets = [l for l in results.split('\n') if l.startswith('* ')]
        if len(bullets) < 5:
            warnings.append(f'PA-W002: Results has {len(bullets)} bullets, < 5')
    # Main Ideas bullet count
    mi_match = re.search(r'## Main Ideas\n\n(.+?)\n## Summary', text, re.DOTALL)
    if mi_match:
        mi = mi_match.group(1)
        bullets = [l for l in mi.split('\n') if l.startswith('* ')]
        if len(bullets) < 3:
            warnings.append(f'PA-W003: Main Ideas has {len(bullets)} bullets, < 3')
    # Summary 4 paragraphs
    s_match = re.search(r'## Summary\n\n(.+?)$', text, re.DOTALL)
    if s_match:
        paras = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r'\n\n+', s_match.group(1)) if p.strip()]
        if len(paras) != 4:
            warnings.append(f'PA-W004: Summary has {len(paras)} paragraphs, expected 4')

# Check abstract length
abs_words = len(details.get('abstract', '').split())
if abs_words < 50:
    warnings.append(f'PA-W008: abstract has {abs_words} words, < 50')

# Categories exist
import os
cat_dir = Path('meta/categories')
existing = {p.name for p in cat_dir.iterdir() if p.is_dir()} if cat_dir.exists() else set()
for c in details.get('categories', []):
    if c not in existing:
        warnings.append(f'PA-W005: category {c} does not exist in meta/categories/')

# DOI null but folder doesn't start with no-doi_
if details.get('doi') is None and not asset_root.name.startswith('no-doi_'):
    warnings.append('PA-W006')

# author country
authors = details.get('authors', [])
has_country = any(a.get('country') for a in authors)
if not has_country:
    warnings.append('PA-W007: no author has non-null country')

# date_published null
if details.get('date_published') is None:
    warnings.append('PA-W009: date_published is null')

print('VALIDATION RESULTS')
print('==================')
print(f'Errors: {len(errors)}')
for e in errors:
    print(f'  ERROR: {e}')
print(f'Warnings: {len(warnings)}')
for w in warnings:
    print(f'  WARN: {w}')
print()
print(f'Asset summary:')
print(f'  paper_id: {details["paper_id"]}')
print(f'  files: {details["files"]}')
print(f'  total file size: {sum((asset_root / f).stat().st_size for f in details["files"])} bytes')
print(f'  summary.md word count: {len(sp.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split())}')
